cand.title: Began construction of a second automotive manufacturing building in Tlajomulco with equipment installation and completion targeted for December 2027.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No accommodation buyer is verified. Relevant routes are Luis Miguel Duran Correa, Production Engineering Manager, who publicly discusses this expansion; Yasuo Hibi, identified by the municipality as president of Daido Metal México; and Luis Eduardo Valdivia Llanes, whose profile lists HR Manager in Tlajomulco. Procurement candidates Kattya R. and Raul Alcantara may help establish vendor onboarding. These are relationship/referral candidates, not confirmed room-block signatories.
findings.futureEdition: No future conference edition or opening ceremony is verified. The municipal October 18, 2026 bulletin reports construction already commencing and completion targeted for December 2027. The company’s August 2026 disclosure plans production in 2028, without a month. Construction falls within November 2026–May 2028; production cannot be assumed to start by May 2028. Exact future activity dates and the machinery-installation schedule are not published in the reviewed sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference, using the supplied hotel positioning: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo could pitch full-service guestrooms and small project-review meetings for visiting engineering, equipment, supplier or management teams. Cross-border collaboration between Mexico, Japan and the USA is reported, but does not establish travel volumes. This is city/business-hotel demand, not a resort programme. Expo adjacency alone does not establish fit: the worksite is in Tlajomulco, outside the supplied Expo/Plaza del Sol target corridor, so actual commute acceptability and transport arrangements must be checked. No Expo event linkage is verified.
findings.venueCommitments: The expansion is committed to DMM’s existing industrial premises, not a hotel: Carretera San Isidro Mazatepec No. 7501, Santa Cruz de las Flores, Tlajomulco de Zúñiga, Jalisco. The groundbreaking took place at the plant. This establishes a project site, not accommodation commitments or available hotel inventory.
findings.historicalRotation: Not an event series; no destination or hotel rotation established. The October 2026 groundbreaking is historical as of November 14, 2026. Municipal references to an initial investment about 15 years earlier are not evidence of recurring events.
findings.accommodationSourcing: UNKNOWN / hotel_sourcing_unconfirmed. No public hotel RFP, room block, incumbent hotel, travel-management company, PCO or accommodation contract was identified. Procurement profiles provide a potential supplier-qualification route, but not proof of hotel purchasing authority. The official Mexico plant switchboard is +52-33-1454-5000. Ask for the person responsible for visiting project-team accommodation and whether bookings are controlled locally, by Japan/USA teams, or by equipment contractors.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate manufacturing project owned by Daido Metal Mexico, S.A. de C.V., within the Daido Metal group; not an association or PCO-led conference. Important correction to the seed: although local coverage calls the company automotive, the company’s expansion disclosure specifically targets generator-engine bearings used in data centers under a production commitment with an unnamed North American diesel-engine manufacturer. The municipality reports MXN 1 billion split equally between infrastructure and equipment; the company describes approximately JPY 4 billion for the building with equipment separately. Do not sum these differently scoped figures.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced incumbent hotel, exclusivity, sold-out dates, overflow requirement or competitor displacement opportunity was found. Inference: plant-access convenience may outweigh Expo adjacency for daily site workers. Do not describe Sheraton as the closest property or claim a drive time without a route check. No room demand should be derived from investment, floor area, jobs or hotel room count.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Use the official plant switchboard to request an introduction to Luis Miguel Duran Correa and the HR/general-administration or purchasing lead responsible for visitor lodging. Confirm remaining 2026–2027 travel waves, installation/commissioning milestones, whether any 2028 stays fall before May 31, origin teams, nights, stay lengths, budgets, incumbent agreements, booking authority and vendor onboarding. Only after demand and commute fit are validated, propose a corporate/project rate with flexible stay lengths, transport options and optional small review meetings. Do not issue a speculative block or represent this as an open RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The groundbreaking has already happened and must be excluded as an upcoming one-time event. The ongoing construction project is a separate, potentially addressable corporate account, but accommodation procurement accessibility remains unknown. Public sources do not establish an open sales window.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional inference: pursue visiting project specialists during remaining construction and equipment installation, and possible start-up travel in 2028 once timing is verified. No future opening celebration or recurring annual meeting is confirmed. This is prospective account capture, not a verified future edition or competitor overflow opportunity.
